capabilities.description: Capture a guest check-in with guest name, room number, number of nights, and arrival time.
Show all of today's check-ins in a live list, indicating which guests have arrived, for the duty manager.
Check whether a room is free for the requested dates and prevent double-booking at check-in.
Store short guest notes and preferences for front-desk staff to see during the stay.
Notify housekeeping and the duty manager when a guest checks in.
Produce an end-of-day summary of arrivals, occupancy, and no-shows for the manager.
Keep a record of who recorded or changed each check-in for accountability.

summary: A lightweight front-desk platform for a 40-room boutique hotel that lets staff quickly record guest check-ins and gives the duty manager a live view of today's arrivals. It replaces paper logs and ad-hoc spreadsheets with a shared, reliable arrival board for small hotel teams.
